_note: Rune stones of the story worlds (src/hell/gold_loot.gd): the account's currency for the talent reset (talents.json reset_runes), shared by every character, never lost. They drop at random, between rare and common: chance = probability per source (mob = a slain enemy, breakable = a broken vase, barrel or crate, chest = an opened chest, boss = a floor guardian, final = the world's last boss, vault = a giant vault), count = stones when it drops. Expected per 10-floor run: about 600 kills, 100 breakables, 40 chests, 9 guardians, 1 final boss, 1-2 vaults: 6 + 6 + 6 + 9 + 2 + 2 = about 30. look: per graphics set the stone's sprite (assets/sprites/loot) and its draw scale (world px per sprite px).
